description: Quartiers de stationnement résidentiel is a dataset listed in Montreuil Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Montreuil. Quartiers de stationnement résidentiel de la ville de Montreuil. Coverage: Montreuil. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are voirie, stationnement. The portal shows 8 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-11-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-montreuil-fr-portal.
